Members of LBF have appeared with groups such as the Ohio Players, George Duke, El Gran Combo, Willie Colon, Horace Silver, Ray Barretto, and Young and Rollins. They have also played with local salsa bands such as Peligro, Tentacion, Sin Miedo, Alfredo Mojica and Friends, and Tumbao. https://www.latinbluesfunk.com/

LAERZ — Thu Oct 1, 7:00 PM — Songbyrd
item.description: LAERZ is an LA based electronic artist redefining what a DJ set can be. Blurring the line between live production and performance, he builds tracks in real time, stacking cinematic vocals, sculpting synths, triggering drum pads, and weaving loops into fully immersive, high voltage moments. No two sets are the same. Every drop is built live. Every chorus feels earned. He first captured global attention through his busking style performances and on the spot content creation, transforming sidewalks and unexpected spaces into stages. That raw, human approach resonated, building a fiercely organic audience of over 4 million followers across social media. That momentum translated offline as well, culminating in a 22 date headline tour that brought his immersive live show to audiences across the country. item.description: Ella Boh is a dark pop artist based in Los Angeles, California crafting haunting melodies, cinematic storytelling, and self-written and self-produced records. She has built one of alternative pop’s fastest-growing communities and cultivated a dedicated global audience through immersive visuals and emotionally raw storytelling. Following the success of her debut project milk & honey, Ella launched her darkest and most ambitious era yet with the BLURRY EP. Led by fan-favorite releases "SERiAL KiLLER," "iNSOMNiAC," and "BLOODY MARY," the project has amassed more than 9.2 million Spotify streams, reached more than 1 million listeners, generated over 400K playlist adds, and contributed to a catalog that now exceeds 56+ million global lifetime streams. The release was supported by more than 14K presaves, international editorial support, and tour dates alongside Artemas and Ari Abdul. item.title: The R&B Club Discusses The Legacy of Aaliyah — Sun Aug 23, 12:00 PM — Songbyrd
item.description: Certain moments in this century have stayed with us. And they always will. August 25, 2001, is just that. It seems almost surreal to say, but The R&B Club’s next event comes almost a quarter-century to the day that the R&B icon Aaliyah tragically passed away. There's no way not to have a connection to her music, but more importantly, Aaliyah herself. If you know anything about us, and what we pride ourselves on, this won't be simply music being played. This is a voyage and a trip back in time into one of the most captivating and abbreviated careers in music history. We’ll discuss it all. The highs, the classic records, where we were when we got the news of her death — and, yes, the R. Kelly of it all. It's one time for Babygirl (better known as Aaliyah) on Sunday, August 23, at the only home we've ever known in Songbyrd. Tickets are $15 in advance and $20 at the door — pending there's any left.
